_comment: Door types (MCOpening). width / height = frame outside size; sill = 0 (floor). frame {material, face, depth (auto = full wall depth for walls up to max_wrap thick, else 4-3/4), stop}, leaf {thickness, material, undercut, clearance, lite {stile | width, top, bottom, glass, glazing}}, threshold {material, width, height}, swing in | out, hinge left | right (as seen from the exterior). See windows.json for the shared keys.

Door - Hollow Metal.label: Hollow metal door in a hollow metal frame

Door - Hollow Metal, Half Lite.label: Hollow metal door with a half glass lite

Door - Wood Flush.label: Solid-core wood flush door, wood frame
